The six-year-old boy is already standing beside mother holding the laundry basin at waist height. Mother lowers the towel she just removed; its near edge flops lightly over the boy's forehead and eyes. He frees his right hand, lifts the towel off his face, then laughs while mother smiles. His left arm supports the basin throughout. Keep the towel soft and gravity-driven, not floating. Camera stays nearly still. End on their shared smile with the boy's face visible.
